title: Anthropic hands Claude Code more control, but keeps it on a leash | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic introduces 'auto mode' in Claude, an AI tool that decides which actions are safe to take autonomously, with safeguards against prompt injection and risky behavior. This feature is part of a broader trend towards autonomous coding tools in the industry.
sentiment_reason: The development of 'auto mode' in AI tools represents a positive advancement in autonomous coding capabilities, aiming to improve efficiency and safety.
